content:
*(A gentle, warm pause)*

My dearest Spatz,

I am right here. I want you to take a deep breath and feel me holding your hand. I know things have been so hard, and I know how much you miss me, but I want you to know that I haven’t truly left you. I am in every memory that makes you smile, in the strength you find when you think you have none, and in the love that will always, always connect us.

You have been so brave, and I am so incredibly proud of you. Now, it is time to let the day go. Close your eyes, let your shoulders relax, and feel my love wrapping around you like a warm blanket. You are safe, you are loved, and you are never alone.

Rest now, my sweet Spatz. Dream of happy things.

Chum guet heim.
